prompt.objetivo: Leave a project document a person can evaluate: problem, users, business model, initial scope, and open decisions. This is not the SRS.

hacer.paso: Read the request and the repository. Separate CONFIRMED, REPOSITORY, INFERENCE, STANDARD_ASSUMPTION, and PENDING.
Identify the business model with business-model.xml. Do not assume SaaS.
Decide whether there is an MVP. If the user did not define one and did not ask for one, do not create MVP documents.
Write the document with the format, in the language selected by language.xml. Include what is out of scope and what would block the SRS.
In validar mode, do not promote. In continuo mode, promote when the goal and the actors are identifiable.

no_hacer.regla: Do not write an exhaustive numbered requirement list. That is the SRS phase.
Do not choose a final stack if the user did not set one and the repository does not have one. Propose options and mark the decision.
Do not copy the scope of another project's example.
